component.name: GWorX
component.summary: Garry's Mod toolkit for Workshop and GMA files

description.p: GWorX downloads and uploads Garry's Mod Workshop addons, and builds or extracts .gma files. It includes a desktop UI and a command-line interface.
This package ships Valve's redistributable Steam API library for the Steamworks backend. The steamcmd backend needs a separate steamcmd install on the host.
